A pulse pistol was a small arms version of pulse weaponry that was one of the most common types of weapons in the galaxy. The standard issue Peacekeeper sidearm fired small bolts of yellow or red energy powered by chakan oil that were able to kill most species save for Scarrans.
These large weapons must usually be mounted to be effectively used. They are typically placed on a tripod and cannot be easily moved. They are capable of burstfire and autofire.

Pulse rifles use Chakan oil cartridges for ammunition; there are no shells. The rifle can be set to overload, causing a large explosion relative to the amount of ammunition remaining. This thick powered armor is used by Peacekeepers during heavy assaults. While cumbersome, it is among the most durable armor available. It will also double as an environmental suit, holding 1 hour of breathable oxygen. Hynerians have developed a similar version for their warriors.
While most civilized species no longer use hide armor, Vorcarians and other primitive species still wear it.

Leather can be found across the galaxy as some of the most utilitarian light armor available. Pirates, merchants, Nebari and even Peacekeeper officers wear light leather armor. Most are made from the hide of Lavviks or similar species, which is fairly tough and durable. Most versions found in black or brown, though they can come in other colors as well.

This armor is used by both Ilanic and Luxan warriors. It is made from a particularly tough plant root, cured and intricately woven into a usable form. While the armor is typically found in red, it can be dyed to different colors.
This armor, also made of reinforced leather, is worn by Peacekeeper Commandos when on a mission.
This somewhat bulky armor, made of tough ceramic material, is common among mercenaries and pirates. Tavleks and Sheyangs both utilize plate armor.

These suits protect the wearer from extreme environments, from space to deep sea, and various temperature extremes. Intense heat (such as fire) will still inflict full damage, but deserts, frozen waste lands, mildly radioactive areas, and other such environments will not affect the wearer. Due to their ongoing war with the Scorvians, the Ilanics developed many warships. The staple of their navy was the Ilanic Cruiser, a massive warship based on the Luxan assault piercer that possessed a tough outer hull and a strong set of defenses.

Delvian Arcs are large science vessels, often filled with numerous forms of plant and animal life. Most of the outer hull in transparent, allowing the residents to look out into space and the planets below from artificial environments within the Arc. Arc have minimal armament, more to dissuade attackers than anything else. They are primarily utilized as science vessels.

Dreadnoughts were gigantic Scarran battleships that were the primary command ships of the Scarran Imperium. These ships were almost twice the size of Peacekeeper command carriers but with inferior firepower. Despite their immense size, Dreadnoughts could generally be overpowered by command carriers in one on one engagements.

Suggestions include, but are not limited to: boarding hatches, shields, increased cargo space, increased passenger capacity, increased Space, extra weapons, hanger, ramming capabilities, reinforced hull, smuggling compartments, increased maneuverability, etc.
Sheyangs do not possess a fleet, though numerous raiding ships can be found throughout space. Their vessels are often heavily modified, due to the amount of technology they scavenge from other ships.

This ship is a mystery wrapped in an enigma. The ship is painted black, has no markings except for its name, Fury of Shadows. Should any attempt to use sensors to scan the ship, the ship instantly activates its jammer, this also happens the moment any kind of targeting lock occurs. The ship seems to be following the players wherever they go, and appears at the edge of sensors range, regardless of …

The ship wins every tie. All dice are rolled as though no wild dice are present, meaning the ship can have no mishaps and no abnormal successes. If the Area Jammer is used, everyone, except the Fury of Shadows, suffers a 10D penalty (10-60, 35 average) to all Sensors and Fire Control related rolls.

A hand-held light source larger than a glow rod, the fusion lantern produces light and heat. The light spreads out from the lantern, producing illumination in a 50 meter radius (although more expensive models can have much longer ranges). Some higher-priced fusion lanterns are considerably larger and heavier, but are capable of generating considerably greater heat, and a brighter beam and radius.
